fields.note: Listings are embedded from BizBuySell platform

notes: Business Broker World does not host listings directly on their website. Instead, they embed listings from BizBuySell.com through an iframe/widget. The page contains a dynamically loaded BizBuySell directory widget (broker ID: 42631). To scrape their actual listings, you would need to: 1) Use a JavaScript-capable scraper (Playwright/Selenium) to render the page and access iframe content, . The static HTML contains no actual listing data - all content is loaded client-side via JavaScript. Both /listings/ and /buyer/ pages use the same embedded widget structure.
